g.text: Each hop uses its own identity; the tool remains read-only.
The caller token stops at APIM, which gets a new token for the backend audience.
HOP 2 · APIM managed identity → read-only API
No caller token or write access
Application-only hop · exact backend audience · exact read scope · not OBO
RUNTIME PATHS · untrusted data cannot change authority
The tool is absent from Foundry and APIM, and the backend identity has read-only access.
A model refusal may support this control but does not enforce it.
